meeting: VPP Insiders discussion: demand-response reporting, VPP technologies, storage barriers
note: An informal peer discussion group, not a decision meeting. That is why it is here: the correct `decisions` list is empty or nearly so, and a model that manufactures four decisions from a wide-ranging conversation is doing the thing this case exists to catch. Facts are attributed by speaker label, never by the personal names participants use for each other in speech, so this key carries no biographical detail about real people.
